define-role.generate.draft: Based on the analysis of the initial attempt, it is crucial to conduct a thorough review of the data to determine the next steps. A collaborative approach with stakeholders may also enhance the effectiveness of subsequent actions.

define-role.critique.requirements_deduped: 1. Conduct a thorough data review. 2. Perform additional data collection if needed. 3. Identify influencing variables. 4. Collaborate with stakeholders for enhanced strategy development.
